title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Build and Embed a Custom Mini Widget (Weather, Currency, World Clock, and more) into Role Center
summary: This post explains how to build a custom mini widget control add-in for Business Central that displays features like weather, currency, and world clock in the role center. It covers the required setup including enabling HttpClient requests and geolocation permissions.
key_points: Custom mini widget can be embedded into Business Central role center with multiple features
Weather feature uses Codeunit 7568 Geolocation to retrieve client device location
HttpClient requests must be enabled in extension target settings
Location permission from client device is required for geolocation functionality
Source code is provided as reference for customization

quotes.text: Since this add-in retrieves data via external APIs, you need to enable 'Allow HttpClient Requests' in the extension target setting before using it.
quotes.why_it_matters: Critical prerequisite for the widget to function properly with external data sources
